title: Doesn't work for mugs.. but...
text: Doesn't work for mugs.. but.... Eh... Purchased this to hang my coffee mugs on the wall as I have a "tiny" home and such little space... but... my mugs were too large... they banged into each other and looked really awkward... Sooooo repurposed in the guest room as clothing hanger.  It's ok... but not what I was hoping for. If you want to hang mugs or cups... they need to have very large handle openings, but be very small in actual cup size.  I always update if useful info comes up...

features: HANG ALL YOUR ESSENTIALS: The graceful arc of hooks holds essentials in every room. Store coats, hats, handbags, scarves, purses, and backpacks in the bedroom or closet. Display mugs, grocery bags, and light skillets and cookware in the kitchen. Hang towels, robes, and headbands in the bathroom. Tidy up coats, scarves, purses, bags, and jackets in the entryway. Conserve shelf space by utilizing walls for storage.

STORAGE DOUBLES AS DÉCOR: Stylish hooks turn storage into wall art. Show off your favorite mugs, collection of colorful scarves, or antique cookware for a unique touch to any room. The empty rack looks stylish and chic, adding some functional fashion to your walls.

STURDY STEEL STORAGE: Steel is strong enough to support your accessories, hats, towels, robes, scarves, bags, backpacks, purses, and more without bending or breaking. Hook rack is reinforced with horizontal rods to support hooks and the items on them.

WALL MOUNTED STORAGE: Easily attach the organizer to your wall. Brackets are built into the design for easy and straightforward mounting; simply secure the organizer to the wall by inserting the screws into the holes and a pre-drilled hole in the wall, then tighten the screws until the rack feels firmly fastened. Mounting hardware included. Included mounting system designed for attaching to wood; alternative surfaces may require specialized hardware.
DIMENSIONS & CARE: 18" L X 2" W X 2.5" H; to clean, wipe with a damp cloth and towel dry.
